registration_caveats: The narrowing to waves {159, 160} rests on a measured-arrival PROXY: the latest tick at which a roster body first took the WARLORD's damage. It depends on his disc reach (a body is 'arrived' when it enters his reach, not hers).
It counts roster bodies only; enemy pets / summons are excluded from tail_share (they are in M-c itself).

The registered reading (Mover.spawn_t_s release schedule) marks all 10 waves kill-limited; the proxy marks only 159 and 160. The registration is the conjunction; the primary-only set is not registered.
